# Bryce McPhail
> Product leader writing long-form essays on how product management is changing in the AI era — signal, delivery, hybrid operators, and what great PMs actually do.

Canonical site: https://bamcphail.github.io/
Prefer the markdown (`.md`) URLs below when available; HTML is fine as fallback.
Author identity: Bryce McPhail — X @bamcphail — LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/bryceam/ — GitHub https://github.com/bamcphail — email mcphail.career@gmail.com

## Core
- [About Bryce McPhail](https://bamcphail.github.io/about.md): Who he is, topics, and links to essays
- [Blog index](https://bamcphail.github.io/index.md): Newest-first list of essays

## Essays (primary theses)
- [Can You Cook?](https://bamcphail.github.io/can-you-cook.md): Great PMs deliver outcomes — not a skills checklist
- [The Hybrid Operator](https://bamcphail.github.io/the-hybrid-operator.md): Best GTM/product teams are hybrid operators who build, sell, and ship
- [Signal is the Bottleneck](https://bamcphail.github.io/signal-is-the-bottleneck.md): Signal — not process, tools, or headcount — is the real PM bottleneck
- [The Future of Product Development](https://bamcphail.github.io/future-of-product-development.md): Where product craft is headed as AI collapses distance between roles
- [TeamRoom](https://bamcphail.github.io/team-room.md): A PM operating system for running teams and shipping work
